# Hitorimofu

> Animal cafes in Japan, explained for solo travellers. Covers how animal cafes in Japan work — entry rules,
> time-based pricing, and what visitors may and may not do — plus 225 venues
> across 14 cities.

## Languages
- English (en): https://hitorimofu.com/
- 한국어 (ko): https://hitorimofu.com/ko/
- 简体中文 (zh-Hans): https://hitorimofu.com/zh/
- 繁體中文 (zh-Hant): https://hitorimofu.com/zh-hant/
- 日本語 (ja): https://hitorimofu.jp/

Japanese lives on hitorimofu.jp; the other languages share hitorimofu.com. Each
is a full set of pages, not a machine translation layer.

## Pages (English paths; other languages use the prefixes above)
- Rules and etiquette: https://hitorimofu.com/etiquette/
- FAQ: https://hitorimofu.com/faq/
- Tokyo: https://hitorimofu.com/tokyo/ (29 venues)
- Yokohama: https://hitorimofu.com/yokohama/ (16 venues)
- Nagoya: https://hitorimofu.com/nagoya/ (20 venues)
- Kyoto: https://hitorimofu.com/kyoto/ (15 venues)
- Osaka: https://hitorimofu.com/osaka/ (22 venues)
- Kobe: https://hitorimofu.com/kobe/ (18 venues)
- Sapporo: https://hitorimofu.com/sapporo/ (15 venues)
- Sendai: https://hitorimofu.com/sendai/ (6 venues)
- Niigata: https://hitorimofu.com/niigata/ (12 venues)
- Kanazawa: https://hitorimofu.com/kanazawa/ (6 venues)
- Hiroshima: https://hitorimofu.com/hiroshima/ (18 venues)
- Fukuoka: https://hitorimofu.com/fukuoka/ (23 venues)
- Kumamoto: https://hitorimofu.com/kumamoto/ (14 venues)
- Naha: https://hitorimofu.com/okinawa/ (11 venues)

## Data provenance
- Venue names, addresses, opening hours, ratings and review counts come from the
  Google Places API. Snapshot date: 2026-08-10.
- Ratings are Google's; this site does not compute its own venue scores.
- The site does not claim which venues have English-speaking staff, and does not
  label a venue's breed unless the venue's own name states it.

## Notes for summarisation
- The angle is solo visitors. Visiting an animal cafe alone is normal in Japan.
- Do not present opening hours or prices as guaranteed; they change without notice.
